HARD RULES: never EXECUTE any target script (not even --help — a repo script here once ran its real enforcer on --help); never read files matching *.env, *secret*, *token*, *key*, *credential*; no MCP, no network, no skills.

CONTEXT: A concurrent session (running on the Omnigent platform; its commits are co-authored 'omnigent') was revamping the SALES process in parallel with a completed Loop Factory v2 effort. That session CRASHED. The owner wants a complete inventory of what it left behind so its work can be finished here.

KNOWN TRACES to start from (verify and expand):
1. /mnt/d_drive/repos/loop-factory — UNCOMMITTED files with its naming convention: wayfinder/MAP.md (vs the v2 session's map.md), wayfinder/tickets/001-gap-audit.md through 014-reconcile-split-tree-lanes.md (zero-padded 0NN vs the v2 session's NN-slug), wayfinder/interviews/revenue-f1-interview-2026-08-02.md. Also .worktrees/ and .polly/ dirs, and pre-existing modified files (ringer/one-true-master/checks/*.py, departments/social/runtime/social_daily.sh local edit). Run git status + git worktree list; read every 0NN ticket and MAP.md fully.
2. Its LANDED commits on loop-factory master: 755741c (#9 drift sensor), b162264 (#10 estate watchdog/deadman), d98778e (#12 OTel step telemetry/scores/budget/rollup) — read the commit messages; the v2 session already merged/composed with these.
3. /mnt/d_drive/repos/open-engine — the sales department lives here (departments/sales/, src/factory/, runtime receipts). Check git log for omnigent-co-authored commits, git status for uncommitted work, git worktree list, and any wayfinder/ or planning docs it left.
4. Search bounded (5 min max) for other omnigent traces: git log --all --grep=omnigent in loop-factory, open-engine, /mnt/d_drive/repos/hubspot-daily-2; ls ~/.polly /mnt/d_drive/repos/loop-factory/.polly 2>/dev/null (shapes only).

DELIVER ./report.md — FIRST LINE 'INVENTORY: N artifacts, M open threads', then: (1) a status table: artifact | which repo | committed/uncommitted | complete/half-done/abandoned-guess | one-line content summary; (2) THE CRASHED MAP: what was its wayfinder MAP.md destination, which of its 001-014 tickets are resolved vs open (read each ticket's status field and resolution), and what its revenue-f1 interview captured (summarize intent, no contact PII); (3) OVERLAP/CONFLICT list vs the v2 session's completed work (v2 map at wayfinder/map.md, tickets NN-*.md — read the map's Decisions-so-far for the v2 side): where the two sessions solved the same problem differently, where the crashed session's open tickets are ALREADY answered by v2 work (name the v2 artifact), and where genuinely unfinished threads remain; (4) FINISH-OUT CANDIDATES ranked: the smallest set of actions to complete or deliberately close the crashed session's threads, each S/M/L. Evidence: file paths + line counts + status fields, quoted sparingly.
tasks.check: python3 -c "import sys,re;from pathlib import Path;p=Path('report.md');t=p.read_text(errors='replace') if p.exists() else sys.exit(print('FAIL: report.md missing') or 1);f=t.strip().splitlines()[0];ok=bool(re.match(r'^INVENTORY: ',f));low=t.lower();need=[('status table','uncommitted|committed'),('crashed map analysis','map.md|destination'),('0NN tickets read','001|gap-audit'),('interview summarized','interview|revenue'),('overlap list','overlap|conflict|already'),('finish-out ranked','finish|candidate|s/m/l|effort')];fails=([] if ok else ['bad first line'])+[n for n,pat in need if not re.search(pat,low)];print('INVENTORY CHECK:','PASS' if not fails else 'FAIL');[print(' -',x) for x in fails];sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)"
tasks.verified: the crashed Omnigent sales session's full residue is inventoried with statuses, its map decoded, overlaps with v2 named, and a ranked finish-out plan produced

READ-ONLY synthesis scout. Deliverable ./report.md only; never execute target scripts; no credential-pattern reads; no MCP.

MISSION (owner): design input for the ULTIMATE automation-creation process — 'Wayfinder + the Factory combined tend to be really good for creating an automation or department.' Two sessions just used variants of this; compare them and everything adjacent, and propose ONE canonical process that creates an automation/department from scratch.

READ FULLY:
1. The Wayfinder skill itself: /home/ankit114/.claude/skills/wayfinder/SKILL.md — the charting/working model (map, tickets, fog, destinations).
2. Session A (v2, completed): /mnt/d_drive/repos/loop-factory/wayfinder/map.md + a sample of its NN-*.md tickets (07, 11, 15, 19, 20) + wayfinder/19-verification-report.md — how Wayfinder drove decisions -> Ringer builds -> executed proof.
3. Session B (crashed sales session): wayfinder/MAP.md + all 0NN tickets (001-014) + interviews/revenue-f1-interview-2026-08-02.md — ITS process variant (note: it ran an F1-style interview inside wayfinder).
4. The Factory's own creation pipeline: runbooks/factory-pipeline.md (F0-F6), interview/INTERVIEW.md + interview/QUESTION_BANK.md, runbooks/process-change-qa.md, runbooks/promotion-ladder.md, factory/scaffold.py (v2-native inheritance: objectives charter, eval registry, runrecord node template, board wiring).
5. Prior art already summarized in wayfinder/research/: 01-graph-agent, 02-knowledge-repo, 03-codebase-harness, 05-bee-notes (control graphs, captain/first-mate, watchers).

ANSWER: (1) PROCESS DIFF — Session A vs Session B wayfinder usage: numbering, ticket types, where interviews happened, how builds were dispatched, how proof was captured; what each did better. (2) SEAM MAP — where Wayfinder ends and F0-F6 begins today; where they overlap (Wayfinder's grilling vs F1 interview; map fog vs F2 concept map; tickets vs F3 node authoring) and where NEITHER covers something (e.g. cadence/timer design, alert contract, objectives definition — check what tonight's triage/objectives work added that no runbook mandates yet). (3) THE ULTIMATE PROCESS PROPOSAL — a single canonical flow 'idea -> running self-healing department on the board', as a numbered stage list where each stage names: who acts (owner/coordinator-brain/Ringer worker), the artifact produced, the executed gate that proves it, and which existing tool implements it (wayfinder skill / interview bank / scaffold / ringer manifest / triage installer). Mark the 2-4 stages where something MUST BE BUILT (missing glue) vs pure documentation. (4) DELIVERABLE RECOMMENDATION: should this land as a skill, a runbook, or a scaffold extension? Recommend one with reasoning.

./report.md FIRST LINE 'ULTIMATE: <n> stages, <m> build-gaps', then the four sections with file:line evidence.
